sloka: आगम्य च पुरीं रम्यामयोध्यां पुरुषर्षभाः ।तानि रत्नानि चित्राणि रामाय समुपाहरन् ।। ७.३९.१२ ॥
transliteration: āgamya ca purīṁ ramyāmayodhyāṁ puruṣarṣabhāḥ ।tāni ratnāni citrāṇi rāmāya samupāharan ।। 7.39.12 ॥

translations.english: Having arrived back in the beautiful city of Ayodhya, those best among men presented the various wonderful jewels to Rama.
